{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=October 2025}} {{Infobox television season | season_name = ''Dancing with the Stars: Athletes'' | bgcolor = #191970 | image = DWTSseason26.jpeg | caption = Promotional poster featuring pro dancers [[Emma Slater]] and [[Keo Motsepe]] | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Erin Andrews]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Adam Rippon]] | professional_winner = [[Jenna Johnson (dancer)|Jenna Johnson]] }} | num_episodes = 4 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{Start date|2018|4|30}} | last_aired = {{End date|2018|5|21}} }} '''Season twenty-six''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'', titled '''''Dancing with the Stars: Athletes''''', premiered on April 30, 2018, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. The four-week season, the shortest ever, featured a cast of current and former athletes.{{cite web |last=Schwartz |first=Ryan |date=April 13, 2018 |title=''Dancing With the Stars'': Athletes Cast Includes Tonya Harding, Adam Rippon, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and More |url=https://tvline.com/2018/04/13/dancing-with-the-stars-season-26-athletes-cast-list-tonya-harding-adam-rippon-dwts/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180414172257/https://tvline.com/2018/04/13/dancing-with-the-stars-season-26-athletes-cast-list-tonya-harding-adam-rippon-dwts/ |archive-date=April 14, 2018 |access-date=April 13, 2018 |website=TVLine}} On May 21, [[Olympic Games|Olympic]] figure skater [[Adam Rippon]] and [[Jenna Johnson (dancer)|Jenna Johnson]] were crowned the champions, while [[Washington Redskins]] cornerback [[Josh Norman]] and [[Sharna Burgess]], and former Olympic figure skater [[Tonya Harding]] and [[Sasha Farber]], were both announced as the runners-up during the live finale. It was later revealed that Josh and Sharna had placed second, while Tonya and Sasha had placed third.{{cite web|title='DWTS' Reveals Official Runner-Up -- Did Tonya Harding or Josh Norman Place Second? |url=https://www.etonline.com/dwts-reveals-official-runner-up-did-tonya-harding-or-josh-norman-place-second-102866?linkId=52048447 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180523172701/https://www.etonline.com/dwts-reveals-official-runner-up-did-tonya-harding-or-josh-norman-place-second-102866?linkId=52048447 |archive-date=May 23, 2018 |access-date=May 23, 2018 |work=[[Entertainment Tonight]] |language=}} == Overview == {{further|Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)}}[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|''Dancing with the Stars'']] is an American [[Reality competition|reality dance competition]] television series that premiered on [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] on June 1, 2005. It is the American version of the British contest program ''[[Strictly Come Dancing]]''. The series pairs celebrities with professional dancers to perform a variety of dance styles, primarily [[Ballroom dance|ballroom]] and [[Latin dance|Latin]] routines. Each couple competes against the others for judges' points and audience votes. The couple receiving the lowest combined total of judges' points and audience votes is usually eliminated each week until only the champion pair remains. ==Cast== ===Couples=== The professional dancers were announced on April 12, 2018. The eight professionals returning from [[Dancing with the Stars (American season 25)|season 25]] were [[Lindsay Arnold]], [[Alan Bersten (dancer)|Alan Bersten]], [[Sharna Burgess]], [[Witney Carson]], [[Artem Chigvintsev]], [[Keo Motsepe]], [[Gleb Savchenko]], and [[Emma Slater]]. The two remaining professional dancers were both in the troupe last season, and had previously been professional dancers on the show: [[Sasha Farber]] and [[Jenna Johnson (dancer)|Jenna Johnson]]. The dance troupe for season 26 consisted of Artur Adamski, [[Brandon Armstrong (dancer)|Brandon Armstrong]], [[Hayley Erbert]], and [[Britt Stewart]]. Additionally, professional dancer Morgan Larson, who performed on the ''Dancing with the Stars: Light Up the Night'' tour, joined the troupe for season 26.{{cite web |last=Murphy |first=Desiree |date=April 12, 2018 |title=''Dancing With the Stars'' pros revealed for all-athlete season |url=https://www.etonline.com/dancing-with-the-stars-pros-revealed-for-all-athlete-season-100199 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180412232242/http://www.etonline.com/dancing-with-the-stars-pros-revealed-for-all-athlete-season-100199 |archive-date=April 12, 2018 |access-date=April 13, 2018 |website=[[Entertainment Tonight]]}} The cast was announced on April 13 on ''[[Good Morning America]]''.{{cite web|url=https://abcnews.go.com/GMA/Culture/adam-rippon-tonya-harding-superstar-athletes-face-off/story?id=54406972|title=Adam Rippon, Tonya Harding and more superstar athletes to face-off in ''Dancing With the Stars'' season 26|website=[[ABC News (United States)|ABC News]]|first=Catherine|last=Thorbecke|date=April 13, 2018|access-date=April 13, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180413153333/https://abcnews.go.com/GMA/Culture/adam-rippon-tonya-harding-superstar-athletes-face-off/story?id=54406972|archive-date=April 13, 2018|url-status=live}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center;" |- ! scope="col" | Celebrity ! scope="col" class="unsortable"| Notability ! scope="col" | Professional partner ! scope="col" | Status ! scope="col" class="unsortable"| {{Abbr|Ref.|Reference}} |- style="height:50px" ! scope="row" | {{sortname|Jamie|Anderson|dab=snowboarder}} | [[Snowboarding at the Winter Olympics|Olympic snowboarder]] | {{sortname|Artem|Chigvintsev}} | style="background:#f4c7b8;" rowspan="2" | {{nowrap|Eliminated 1st & 2nd}}
